_doc: Expected output per case id of the input file. A response that differs is a Locust failure (Spec04 §5).

cases.goal: HOT read: many customers ask the same popular question (main hub, oil change, gasoline car, next 7 days). After the first miss every answer is a cache hit → p95 budget 'GET /availability [hot]' in thresholds.json.

COLD read: a random date 1–60 days ahead (brake service, diesel car) at the hub → mostly cache misses, computed from PostgreSQL. Tests the miss path and stampede protection, budget 'GET /availability [cold]'.

UTC+14 (Kiritimati): 'from/to' are LOCAL dates. Opening 08:00 local is 18:00Z of the PREVIOUS UTC day; one oil-change technician, 08:00–16:00, 60 min, 15-min step → exactly 29 slots, first at local 08:00, last at local 15:00.
The whole window must fit the opening hours: Express Kiosk is open 09:00–10:00, wheel alignment takes 25 min → only 09:00, 09:15, 09:30. 09:45 would end at 10:10 and must NOT be offered.
Never bookable → 200 with an EMPTY list, not an error: hydrogen car (no bay or technician takes it, D2).
Never bookable → empty list: a dealership with technicians but NO bays (needs both resources at once).
Range guard: 15 days (> 14) is rejected with 400 BEFORE any DB work — a spammer cannot ask for a year at once.
Missing vehicleTypeId and a malformed dealership id → 400 (not 500 from a failed UUID parse).
Unknown dealership (valid UUID, no row) → 404, and it is not cached as an empty slot list.
